items.title: Stella Oliver Interview, 1959-04-22
items.q: Paul Barbrun also. He was playing on drums then.

ctx.x: Is that Paul Barbrun? Do you remember? Paul Barbrun. Paul Barbrun also. He was playing on drums then. Yes. And they played around New York for a long time. They did fairly well but not much because men began to get tired and Ory was there too. He began to spit. He began to leave Joe. Because he wasn't so strong anymore and all that traveling around and disappointment and all. And Joe was quite disappointed.
I heard once that Joe had some trouble with his teeth about that time. Is that true?
